The generic PLAN question could be more specific, but no extra substantive repair is counted for that wording. The isolated unassigned word 'At' is cosmetic clutter, not a missing factual unit or a separate substantive edit.

The cabinet-label event remains available and retains one complete checklist unit; three further units need restoration or completion. No accepted facts are discarded merely because another event failed. No visible factual or suggestion assertion independently reverses the source in this variant.

case_assessment: A places eight checklist units, but changes the cause of the cabinet-label no-delay finding and places the delivery event in ACTION. B places six units and preserves the cabinet-label record, while the copier entry changes the meaning of the 08:19 response and leaves situation/update details outside their intended fields; its assistance also assumes an unsupported preventive-maintenance subtype. C places one unit and requires reconstruction of the failed copier event plus three cabinet-label units. Source retention and separately marked proposals remain useful safeguards, but do not count as correctly placed factual units. These are case-specific AI-assisted judgments and repair counts, not model selection, accuracy estimates or measured review time.
